# 00000001141

**LT-41 ★** — source: 27_李理论与代数群.md

**English.** Definition: The restricted enveloping algebra u(g) of a restricted Lie algebra g. Conjecture: The Krull dimension of the center of u(slₙ) is n−1 (generated by the p-centers of the various sl₂-sections), and for every reductive g the center of u(g) is spanned by the Weyl-invariant polynomial ring of the p-center, with dimension always equal to the rank.

**中文。** 定义：限制李代数 g 的限制包络代数 u(g)。猜想：u(slₙ) 的中心的 Krull 维数为 n−1(由各 sl₂-截面的 p-中心生成),且 u(g) 的中心对一切约化 g 由 Weyl 群不变的 p-中心多项式环张成,维数恒等于秩。
